column1: # Vaccine name or code -> vaccine group. A recorded immunization joins a group when its CVX code is listed
# (code_system cvx) or when one of the names appears in its text as whole words (accents and case ignored).
# A code written !N never counts for the group, even when the record's name matches one of its names.
# A record whose code is listed in any group (with or without !) joins groups by that code only; its
# name counts only when it has no listed code. A name written !word keeps a record with no listed code
# out of the group when the word appears in its text.
# The schedules cite a conjugate pneumococcal vaccine and the recombinant zoster vaccine, so the
# polysaccharide PPSV23 (CVX 33) and the live zoster vaccine (CVX 121) do not count.
